FINDINGS.ISSUE: PROJECTED_MANIFEST.ROOT_OBJECT_FIELDS does not contain OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT. It contains projected_blocker_count, but the schema does not define projected_blocker_count as exactly the unique-dedup-key OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT specified in COUNTING. Mission Fence authority stores OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT separately, and activation requires that value to equal zero.
FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A producer can publish one valid projected ROOT_OBJECT/hash and separately surface an OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT value that is not cryptographically bound as an explicit root field. Unless every consumer independently recomputes the count from rows and rejects mismatch, root identity and activation count are not a single atomic fact.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Add open_control_p0_count as an explicit ROOT_OBJECT field and define its exact JSON type/value derivation, or normatively require every Mission Fence writer/validator to recompute it from the hashed rows and reject any separately supplied mismatch.
Define projected_blocker_count unambiguously as identical to, or distinct from, open_control_p0_count. If distinct, define both and bind both.

FINDINGS.ISSUE: P0_CLASSIFICATION.NON_P0_RULE and STATUS_CLASSIFICATION.terminal_nonblocking_rule permit external severity/status taxonomy artifacts, but SNAPSHOT_BINDING and PROJECTED_MANIFEST.ROOT_OBJECT_FIELDS define no explicit severity_taxonomy_blob_sha/status_taxonomy_blob_sha fields, canonical taxonomy path, or null/absent semantics.
FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two projectors pinned to the same control tree and projection schema can select different candidate taxonomy artifacts or disagree whether a taxonomy is authorized, producing different classifications without one schema-defined taxonomy identity to validate first.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define canonical severity/status taxonomy artifact identity fields, source/path authority, allowed absence semantics, and exact blob SHA binding.
Include those taxonomy identities in snapshot binding and the projected root object whenever taxonomy-dependent classification is permitted.

SAFE_PROPERTIES_CONFIRMED: Exact terminal nonblocking default is fail-closed for RESOLVED/CLOSED/SUPERSEDED only.
Unknown P0 classification and unknown control relevance block zero proof.
Partial search/shard coverage cannot prove zero.
Independent review is required for semantic control relevance and dedup decisions.
ACTIVATION_IMPACT: CONTROL_P0_PROJECTION_V2 SHOULD NOT BE CANONICALLY ADOPTED OR USED TO PROVE OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0 UNTIL THE FINDINGS ABOVE ARE REPAIRED AND INDEPENDENTLY RE-REVIEWED.
